text:
Jessie M: quick sync  axis unit + legend + outlier UX for Console charts. panels with p95 + 8 series look cramped. vote: `/s` on-axis or `req/s`?
Adrian P: `/s` keeps density. tooltip can show full text: 'Requests per second (req/s)'.
Marta H: agree. Also proposal: add tiny units dropdown in panel header (per sec / per min / raw) so users can switch without changing dashboard config. remembers per-user.
Jessie M: smoothing + legend problem: turning smoothing on currently duplicates legend rows. idea: render smoothed as primary and collapse raw into a muted single-line with 'Show raw' action.
Adrian P: sounds right. make collapsed row focusable and set aria-expanded, label say 'Raw series hidden'.
Marta H: on outliers, PM asked for "clean view". Two approaches: hard clip vs visual de-emphasis. prefer de-emphasis (alpha/stroke) + optional sentinel marker for spikes. keep values intact.
QA-Bot: A11Y checklist: 1) announce toggles via aria-live ("Outlier de-emphasis enabled"). 2) faded points must remain keyboard-focusable and have offscreen text like 'value X (de-emphasized)'. 3) collapsed legend rows need visible focus and aria-expanded.
Adrian P: microcopy suggestion: label: 'De-emphasize outliers' helper: 'Fade isolated spikes visually; values unchanged.' Keep helper <80 chars.
Jessie M: CSS hint for collapsed legend:
```.legend-row--muted { color: var(--muted-500); font-size:12px }
.legend-row--muted:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--focus) }
```
Marta H: keyboard shortcut: `L` focus legend, arrows to move, Enter toggles raw expand/collapse. Document in shortcuts.
DesignAssist: PR checklist: feature flag `console.featureFlags.chartNoiseReducer`, aria strings, tooltip unit copy (sentence case), keyboard tests, a11y unit test asserting aria-live message.
Jessie M: I'll mock variants (none / fade / clip) in Figma and open PR behind the flag. pinging beta when ready.
